draft.emotion: quiet and peaceful, settling down after a long day
notes: Compare with 'tối' (evening/early night, roughly 6–10 p.m.): 'đêm' refers to late night (after about 10 p.m.) or the whole night until dawn.
Commonly used in 'ban đêm' (at night / nighttime) and 'đêm qua' (last night).

senses.definition: The dark part of the twenty-four-hour day, especially late at night until sunrise.
